title: Synthetic video test harness for simulated drowsiness and fault scenarios
description: Implement tests/synthetic_feed_harness.py to simulate camera feeds with deterministic frame sequences (normal blinking, prolonged eye closure, head turn/occlusion, and camera disconnection) to verify end-to-end alert escalation deterministically (PRD 11).
acceptanceCriteria: Generates synthetic image sequences for: normal blinking, 2s eye closure (Stage 1), 4s eye closure (Stage 2), 6s eye closure (Stage 3), and face occlusion
Pumps synthetic frames into CameraService and verifies AlertManager reaches corresponding stages
Asserts that ordinary short blinks (100-300ms) do NOT trigger critical alerts (PRD 10)
Verifies transitions to Monitoring Unavailable upon occlusion without false alerts
Automated test passes deterministically without a real webcam attached

steps.description: Create synthetic frame generator in tests/synthetic_feed_harness.py
steps.details: Generate test frames with simulated faces with open eyes vs closed eye slits drawn using OpenCV primitives.
Create test runner feeding sequences at 30 FPS into CameraService/StateMachine pipeline and recording stage transitions.

steps.description: Write automated test cases in tests/test_drowsiness_pipeline.py
steps.details: Test case 1: normal blinking -> state stays NORMAL. Test case 2: 1.5s closure -> STAGE_1. Test case 3: 3.5s closure -> STAGE_2. Test case 4: 5.5s closure -> STAGE_3. Test case 5: no face -> UNAVAILABLE.
Run pytest tests/test_drowsiness_pipeline.py and ensure 100% pass rate in headless environments.

technicalNotes: Critical acceptance test for PRD 10: proving alerts trigger deterministically and short blinks are rejected.
Enables reproducible CI/CD testing without hardware webcams.
